title: Devices
description: Connect and test the equipment you use at checkout: printer, cash drawer, barcode scanner, and payment terminal.

emptyState.title: No devices yet
emptyState.body: Add a device so Puntovivo can use it. Your current printer will remain available even if you do not add it here.

fields.configHelp: For a network-connected ESC/POS printer, use a private IP address and a port from 9100 to 9103.
fields.configInvalidJson: The configuration is not valid JSON. Check for missing quotes, commas, or braces.

autoPrintOnComplete.label: Print automatically when a sale closes
autoPrintOnComplete.help: Sends the receipt to this printer when the cashier confirms the sale. The drawer also opens when you enable that option in the printer's advanced configuration.
autoPrintOnComplete.systemHelp: Open the system print dialog after each sale. Select a local system printer in desktop settings before enabling silent printing.

gs1.title: GS1 weight and price labels
gs1.help: Assign each in-store prefix to the value encoded by this site's scale. Unused prefixes are treated as ordinary barcodes.
gs1.invalid: The GS1 prefix configuration is invalid. Assign at least one prefix and do not reuse a prefix for weight and price.

fields.paperWidthHelp: Match the printer roll: 58 mm uses 32 columns; 80 mm uses 48. Configure the receipt template separately.
fields.unsupportedTransport: Direct USB and serial ESC/POS are not implemented. For a USB printer, use System with its operating system driver.
fields.hostPlaceholder: Enter the printer’s actual private IP address
fields.hostRequired: Enter the printer’s actual network address. A USB cable does not provide a TCP address.
fields.networkOnly: Network printers only. Enter the address shown by your printer or network administrator. Connecting a USB cable does not make this network configuration work.
fields.systemRoute: For USB printers, install the operating system driver and use System. Choose the local printer and send a test ticket in the system-printer section. Match the OS paper size to the receipt template.

toast.errorBody: Review the configuration and try again.
toast.registrationChecked: Device registration checked — no paper test
toast.testStale: The connection changed while this test was running. Test the current connection again.

confirmRemove.title: Remove device
confirmRemove.body: Are you sure you want to remove this device? Puntovivo will use the default checkout settings when it is no longer available.
